title: elaphoglossum auricomum
intro: Elaphoglossum auricomum, commonly known as the golden lip fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum auricomum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
